text: HTML defines content, CSS decorates it and helps tell how it is displayed. CSS stands for Cascading Stylesheet. This means that there is a hierarchy of style attributes overwriting other attributes that affect the same elements. Think of it like this. Bob Ross does an oil painting and starts off with a canvas covered in liquid white. This is the lowest level on the hierarchy. It applies to the entire body of the painting, like a class applied to the body tag. On that he paints some divs of class " mountain ". The mountain class has the attribute paint - color: Van Dyke Brown. Since the div is within body the paint - color: Van Dyke Brown attribute overwrites the liquid white and you see the Van Dyke Brown over the liquid white.
